info.name: Exactly Protocol Auditor ERC-4626 Fixed Rate API
Deposit assets at a fixed rate maturity pool

items.docs: Deposits assets into a specific maturity pool to earn a fixed rate of return. The minAssetsRequired parameter protects against slippage.

info.name: Withdraw assets from a fixed rate maturity pool

items.docs: Withdraws a fixed deposit position before or at maturity. Early withdrawal incurs a discount; at or after maturity no discount applies.

info.name: Borrow assets at a fixed rate maturity pool

items.docs: Borrows assets from a specific maturity pool at a fixed interest rate. The maxAssets parameter limits slippage on the borrow fee.

info.name: Repay a fixed rate borrow at maturity

items.docs: Repays a fixed-rate borrow position at or before its maturity date. Early repayment may qualify for a discount.
